name: opencode-sidecar
displayName: Sidecar for OpenCode: Chat Sidebar & GUI
description: OpenCode chat sidebar and GUI for VS Code, Cursor and VSCodium: every agent step on one timeline, live subagents, diffs, @ mentions, images, permissions, fork and rewind.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: OpenCode can read files and run commands in the workspace, so the sidebar requires a trusted workspace.

opencodeSidecar.executablePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `opencode` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH` and common install locations.

opencodeSidecar.serverUrl.markdownDescription: URL of a running OpenCode server, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4096`. Leave empty to use the OpenCode background service discovered on this machine. Non-loopback URLs are refused unless `#opencodeSidecar.allowRemoteServer#` is enabled.

opencodeSidecar.allowRemoteServer.markdownDescription: Allow `#opencodeSidecar.serverUrl#` to point at a non-loopback host. Off by default.

opencodeSidecar.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Optional default model as `providerID/modelID` (for example `opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code`). Used when the workspace has no remembered selection.

opencodeSidecar.defaultAgent.markdownDescription: Optional default agent/mode id (for example `build` or `plan`).

opencodeSidecar.autoStart.markdownDescription: Start the OpenCode background service automatically when the sidebar opens and no service is running.

opencodeSidecar.showUsage.markdownDescription: Show context-window and cost figures reported by OpenCode.

opencodeSidecar.stickyPrompt.markdownDescription: Keep the prompt of the turn you are reading pinned to the top of the chat while you scroll.

opencodeSidecar.statusWords.markdownDescription: While the agent works, show playful words (such as *Riding along…*), a new one every few seconds, next to the animated mark. Off shows *Working…*.

opencodeSidecar.cacheWarmMinutes.markdownDescription: How long your provider keeps a prompt cached, in minutes. The clock in the message box estimates from this when the cache goes cold (OpenCode reports cache tokens, not the timer). It shows only when the model reports prompt-cache tokens. `0` hides the clock.

enumDescriptions: Every tool call on its own row.
Consecutive tool calls folded into one line ("Explored · 2 searches, 3 reads").
opencodeSidecar.activity.markdownDescription: How tool activity shows in the chat.

opencodeSidecar.showStatusBarItem.markdownDescription: Show an **OpenCode** item in the Status Bar that opens the chat and shows the connection state.

opencodeSidecar.budget.default.markdownDescription: Task budget used when a workspace has no remembered choice. The budget is a local safety limit per task (one agent run); it only uses cost and step figures reported by OpenCode.

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

maxCost.description: Maximum task cost in USD (0 disables this metric).

maxSteps.description: Maximum agent steps per task (0 disables this metric).

opencodeSidecar.budget.warnPercent.markdownDescription: Warn when a task reaches this percentage of its budget.

opencodeSidecar.budget.contextWarnPercen.markdownDescription: Warn when the context window is this full (warning only, never stops the agent). `0` disables the warning.

opencodeSidecar.notifications.taskComple.markdownDescription: Show a notification when an OpenCode task completes. Not shown while you are watching the chat (view visible and VS Code focused).

opencodeSidecar.notifications.needsInput.markdownDescription: Show a notification when OpenCode needs your input (a question or a permission request), saying what it asks. Not shown while you are watching the chat (view visible and VS Code focused), where the request already takes the message box's place.

opencodeSidecar.notifications.taskFailed.markdownDescription: Show a notification when an OpenCode task fails.

opencodeSidecar.notifications.budgetStop.markdownDescription: Show a notification when Budget Guard stops a task.

scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node out-test/test/acceptance/runAcceptance.js
scripts.test:webview: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec "out-test/test/webview/*.test.js"
